exposure: Bowel rest with total parenteral nutrition
outcome: Successful delivery of a healthy infant
cohort: A 20-year-old woman with known Gorham-Stout Disease who presented with shortness of breath and bilateral chylothoraces at 18 weeks of pregnancy.
finding: The management of Gorham-Stout Disease complicated by refractory chylothoraces during pregnancy is challenging due to limited treatment options and requires a multidisciplinary healthcare team to ensure successful maternal and fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: A healthy infant was successfully delivered by cesarean section.
